content: SEG: the position of the character in a word segment. For example, given the word “wAlktAb” (والكتاب> and the book/writers), which is composed of 3 segments “w+Al+ktAb” (و+ال+كتاب>). Letters were marked as “B” if they begin a segment, “M” if they are in the middle of a segment, “E” if they end a segment, and “S” if they are single letter segments. So for “w+Al+ktAb”, the corresponding character positions are “S+BE+BMME”. We used Farasa to perform segmentation, which has a reported segmentation accuracy of 99% on the WikiNews dataset BIBREF36.
